description: Continuous immersion in graphic content and live updates extends the reach of the violence, makes disengagement difficult, and can trigger anxiety, depression and PTSD-like symptoms in people who are physically safe.
energy_note: Injured by a device you are holding voluntarily.

aspect: Recognising the geography is what does the damage
description: A generic war video is distressing. A video of the junction where you bought bread for eleven years is something else, and the algorithm cannot tell the difference so it serves more of it.
energy_note: The feed learns exactly which street to show you.

description: Outward normality - meetings, school runs, small talk - running at the same time as worry, grief and anger, with no overlap between the two. Clinicians name this directly in the diaspora literature.
energy_note: Two lives, neither of them fully attended.

aspect: You cannot look away because looking is the only participation available
description: Putting the phone down feels like abandonment. So the person keeps watching, knowing it helps nobody, because stopping would mean accepting that nothing they do helps anybody.
energy_note: Doomscrolling as a form of loyalty.
